block-guide:
CORE/HTML (Custom HTML) Static HTML written between the block comments and printed as it is. For markup no installed block gives (a table with a special shape, a details/summary, a definition list). Text, headings, images, buttons and columns go into their own blocks: those the editor can change and the theme styles. MARKUP (the HTML is the content; no attributes)
Do you ship abroad?

Yes, to the EU and the UK.

WHAT THESE TOOLS ACCEPT WordPress's post-safe HTML: div, span, p, headings, a, img, lists, table, details/summary, figure, video/audio, label, textarea; class, id, aria-*, data-* and inline style (also grid, background url()). Checked: all of these save. REFUSED (the save names the element or attribute, and nothing is saved): script, style, iframe, svg, canvas, form, input, select, link and object elements; on* event handlers (onclick, onerror…); javascript:, vbscript: and data: addresses.
